name: ai.financial-portfolios/financial-portfolios-ai
title: Financial Portfolios AI
description: Systematic model portfolios: allocations, holdings history, model-alignment arithmetic, research.

environmentVariables.name: FINANCIAL_PORTFOLIOS_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal API token (aqat_v1_...) from Settings > API Tokens. Remote connectors use OAuth 2.1 instead.

environmentVariables.name: FINANCIAL_PORTFOLIOS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Portal origin the server calls, when running locally. Or set FINANCIAL_PORTFOLIOS_ENV to dev or prod. One of the two is required.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.disclosure: Informational and educational purposes only. Not investment, legal, or tax advice, and not a recommendation or solicitation. No suitability assessment has been performed. All outputs represent mathematical target-model alignment arithmetic.
